title: 01/03/2025 - Software Updates
content:
## 01/03/2025 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102956

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

- We fixed an issue that was preventing the system from correctly encoding URLs in some cases.

- We improved the error handling of the File Upload form field to provide more informative messages when a file cannot be uploaded.

- We implemented a security update to the Search Members page in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue that was causing the system to display expired posts on post search result pages in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Group - Search Query

- We updated the decline lead modal to allow members to provide feedback as to why they are declining a lead.  This information will then display on the Match Leads page in the Admin. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Leads Details Page - New Lead System

- We added a new API Endpoint to the Brilliant Directories API which allows fetching information about a member's transactions via user_id.

- We updated the layout of the "My Imports" tab on the Business Data page to enable exporting the member data for each individual import.

- We updated the Stock Photo Library Add-On when uploading cover photo images to hide the orientation field and remove the alt attribute on the cover photo image. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Profile Image Upload Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Single Photo Upload

- We created a new Membership Plan Setting called "Logged In Member Main Menu". This setting allows Admins to choose a different Main Menu to display for each Membership Plan when a member is logged in on the website. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings Bootstrap Theme - Header - Main Menu

- We added the ability to select multiple forms when using the "Filter Forms" field on the Forms Inbox page in the Admin.

- We added additional security to the member login form on the frontend of sites.

- We added the ability to sort members by "Most Views" and "Most Likes" on the Search Members page in the Admin when the Profile Statistics and Bookmark Favorites Add-Ons are enabled on the site.

- We updated the 301 Redirects tool to allow creating 301 Redirects for URLs that contain parameters.

- Emails sent from the system will now include a link-unsubscribe header to improve deliverability and will automatically add any bounced or failed email addresses to the unsubscribe list after sending a Newsletter from the Admin.
